NBA_MINUTES_ENGINE_V1.hypothesis: Structural absorption prior gave deep-bench players most of an absent player's minutes and counted long-gone players as absent; P(DNP) for end-of-bench was underestimated.
Competition for minutes: P(DNP) of bench players depends on own recent DNP rate AND how many available teammates sit above them in the rotation (pooled logistic).

NBA_MINUTES_ENGINE_V1.hypothesis: Starter residual SD is underestimated because the ridge fit consumes degrees of freedom; correct by 1/(1-p_eff/n_eff), no fixed inflation.
NBA_MINUTES_ENGINE_V1.decision: NOT PROMOTED. Significant minutes-level gain, but end-to-end props mixed (PTS/AST MAE slightly worse, PRA Brier slightly better). Runs in shadow on the same prospective games (data/live/shadow_STACK_V3_SIGMA.db).

NBA_MINUTES_ENGINE_V1.reason: CRPS worse (2.970 vs 2.966) and starter coverage worse (0.745 vs 0.755); MAE gain negligible.

NBA_MINUTES_ENGINE_V1.hypothesis: Minutes depend on garbage time (PBP: Q4 time with lead >= 25/20/15 at 12-9/9-6/<6 min), not linearly on final margin; coaches differ in how fast they pull starters; fringe players enter blowouts. Pregame: simulated margin -> G drawn from historical games with similar |margin| (training games only).

NBA_MINUTES_ENGINE_V1.decision: NOT PROMOTED (shadow). Minutes gains significant in 2 of 4 out-of-sample cohorts, same direction but ns in the other 2; props mixed (PTS CRPS better 2025-26, REB Brier worse 2026-27). Runs prospectively in shadow_STACK_V4_BLOWOUT.db.

rules.SINGLE: one availability scenario: BASE rows are the published distribution
rules.MIXTURE: every enumerated status has a justified empirical play rate (and the window is within max_minutes_before_tip): exact draw-level mixture published (minutes 'MIXTURE', props/game 'MIX'), weights frozen + hashed at snapshot time
rules.CONDITIONAL: no justified weights: each scenario is a separate conditional forecast; settled only for the scenario whose conditions actually happened; no mixture published
